cardOverview.overviewText: A Prime SBI Amex variant providing milestone shopping vouchers, accelerated rewards on dining and groceries, and concierge services.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: American Express Dining Platform
benefitRows.offer: American Express Dining Platform – Discover delectable dining offers and enjoy up to 25% discount in your city.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the American Express Dining Platform using your registered account. Browse available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining privileges. Complete the payment using your SBI Prime credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accident cover (worth 50 lakhs), fraud liability cover (worth 1 lakh) applicable from 48 hours prior to 7 days post reporting about the loss of the card to the bank.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the American Express Dining Platform using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 25% discount at participating restaurants. Complete the payment using your SBI Prime (SBI: AMEX) credit card to unlock the offer.
